mcq_drop.why: opinion item (reforms 'demanded'); not a factual exam question

patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: Ujjwala is meant for women / its objective is free LPG to BPL women; RMK set up 1993; Stand-Up India for greenfield enterprises.
Count/structure questions: MWCD schemes grouped under three umbrella missions; Mahila e-Haat = MWCD web marketing platform.
'Which is NOT correct' items on girl-child schemes (BBBP, Sukanya, Balika Samriddhi) and flagship-programme lists recur.
PMMVY year: APPSC key gives 2016 (announced Dec 2016); app notes use 2017 (implemented Jan 2017) - be aware of both.
App MCQs go deeper into Mission Shakti sub-components (Sambal/Samarthya, Nari Adalat) and AP schemes than PYQs show.
